meta.title: Host with Gharmish
meta.description: Partner with Gharmish to host authentic Aseeri experiences. See who can host, how the partnership works, what to prepare, and how payouts work — then apply.

hero.title: Host the Aseer you know.
hero.intro: Gharmish is a partnership marketplace, not a passive listing site. We work alongside a small circle of local hosts — with photography, training, and distribution — and share the upside fairly.
hero.meta: Applying doesn't list anything yet. Our partnerships team reviews every application and follows up to talk through payouts, licensing, and the experience you'd love to host.

audience.heading: Who can host
audience.intro: We partner with people who know Aseer firsthand — whether you host on your own or through a registered tourism business. You should have a genuine tie to the region's culture, landscape, or community.

individuals.title: Individuals
individuals.body: Saudi nationals and residents with a national ID or Iqama, hosting in their own name. A tourism or freelance permit helps but we'll guide you on what's needed.

companies.title: Registered companies
companies.body: Tour operators and activity businesses with a commercial registration and the relevant tourism licence, hosting under the company name.

partnership.heading: How the partnership works
partnership.intro: We co-create with you rather than just list you. That means real support behind every experience, so the quality stays high and the story stays yours.

photography.title: Photography
photography.body: We shoot your experience professionally so it looks its best across the marketplace.

training.title: Training
training.body: We help you shape the experience, set expectations, and deliver a consistent, memorable day.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.body: We bring guests who value the real thing — Saudi travelers first, international visitors as we grow.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Sign in and tell us about yourself, your languages, and how you'd like to host. It takes a few minutes.

review.title: We review and verify
review.body: Our partnerships team reviews your application and verifies your identity and licences. We follow up personally — no automated rejections.

build.title: We build it together
build.body: Once you're approved, we co-create the experience with you — photography, pricing, and the details that make it feel like Aseer.

earn.title: Publish and earn
earn.body: Your experience goes live. You manage availability from your dashboard, and you have {approvalHours} hours to accept each booking request.

documents.heading: What you'll need
documents.intro: Have these ready before you apply — you can upload them during the application, and our team reviews them before your first listing goes live.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: National ID or Iqama for individuals; the authorized signatory's ID for companies.

licence.title: Registration and licence
licence.body: Commercial registration and a tourism licence for companies; a tourism or freelance permit where you have one.

vat.title: VAT certificate
vat.body: Your VAT registration certificate, if your business is VAT-registered. Optional otherwise.

iban.title: Bank details
iban.body: A Saudi IBAN and, if we ask, an IBAN letter from your bank so we can pay your earnings.

documents.privacy: Photos or PDFs, up to 4MB each. Documents are stored privately, used only to verify you and pay you, and never shown to guests.

payout.heading: Payouts and responsibility
payout.revenueShare: Gharmish takes a fair revenue share, agreed with you as part of your partnership — we'll walk you through the numbers before anything is signed.
payout.payouts: You're paid when a booking is completed. We transfer what you're owed to your Saudi IBAN and record every transfer in the payout ledger in your dashboard, where you can update your IBAN anytime.
payout.liability: Hosts are solely responsible and fully liable for the experiences they deliver. Gharmish does not provide insurance — please make sure you're properly covered for the activities you host.

cta.title: Know Aseer like nobody else?
cta.body: Tell us about yourself and the experience you'd love to host. We'll take it from there.

trustSafety.title: Booked with confidence, hosted with care.
trustSafety.intro: Every experience on Gharmish is curated, every host is vetted in person, and every payment is protected. Here's what stands behind your booking.

vetting.heading: Every host is vetted
vetting.body: Hosts join Gharmish by application, not by sign-up. We verify identity documents and tourism licences, review every experience in person before it goes live, and work with hosts on safety planning. The Verified badge means a real person on our team has checked.

payments.heading: Your money is protected
payments.body: Payments run through a licensed Saudi payment gateway with 3-D Secure — card details never touch our servers. For request-to-book experiences you aren't charged until the host accepts, and if a host declines or doesn't respond in time, nothing is charged at all.

insurance.heading: Safety on the ground
insurance.body: Every host is identity-verified before their first listing goes live, and each experience page spells out what to bring, minimum ages, and fitness expectations — so you know exactly what you are signing up for before you book.

support.heading: We're close by
support.body: Gharmish is run from Abha, not a call centre. Every booking page has a direct "report a problem" line that reaches our team, and confirmed bookings unlock a WhatsApp line to your host for day-of coordination.

community.heading: Honest reviews, gated by real bookings
community.body: Only guests who completed a booking can review it — one review per booking, and hosts can reply once. No purchased ratings, no anonymous noise.

howItWorks.title: From browsing to the mountain top.
howItWorks.intro: Gharmish connects you with vetted local hosts across Aseer. Here's how booking works for guests — and how hosting works if you'd like to join the other side.

guests.heading: For guests
guests.intro: Booking takes a few minutes, and you always know where you stand.
guests.step1: Browse experiences and pick a date — every listing shows its real availability calendar.
guests.step2: Book it: Instant Book experiences confirm right away; request-to-book experiences go to the host, who responds within {hours} hours.
guests.step3: Pay securely with mada, Visa, or Mastercard. For requests, you only pay after the host accepts.
guests.step4: Get your e-ticket and a WhatsApp line to your host. Show up — everything else is arranged.

bookingTypes.heading: Instant Book vs. Request to book
bookingTypes.instant: Instant Book — marked with a lightning badge. Your spot is confirmed the moment payment goes through. No waiting.
bookingTypes.request: Request to book — the host checks they can take your group and responds within {hours} hours. You won't be charged until they accept; if they decline or time runs out, you pay nothing.

hosts.heading: For hosts
hosts.intro: We're a partnership marketplace: we co-create experiences with you, not just list them.
hosts.step1: Apply with your story and what you'd like to host. Our team reviews every application.
hosts.step2: We verify your identity and licences, then build the experience with you — photography included.
hosts.step3: Choose how bookings confirm: instantly against your calendar, or with your approval per request.
hosts.step4: Host your guests and track earnings and payouts from your dashboard.

cancellationPolicyPage.title: Plans change. Here's exactly what happens.
cancellationPolicyPage.intro: Three clear policies, in plain language — the same rules our system actually enforces, fixed on your booking the moment you book, with no fine print.

freeWindow.heading: Free cancellation window
freeWindow.body1: You can cancel any booking before it starts, from your booking page. Every experience shows one of three cancellation policies: Flexible (full refund until 24 hours before the start), Moderate (full refund until 48 hours before, then a 50% refund until 24 hours before) or Strict (full refund until 7 days before, then 50% until 48 hours before). The policy shown when you booked is the one that applies — it never changes after you book.
freeWindow.body2: Two extras apply on top of any policy: cancel within 24 hours of booking (while the start is still at least 48 hours away) and you're always refunded in full; and you can move a booking to another open date once, free of charge, within the window your policy allows. Past a policy's last refund step the booking can still be cancelled, but the payment is not refunded — your host has already planned and turned others away.

requests.heading: Booking requests
requests.body1: A request-to-book costs nothing to send. The host has {hours} hours to accept or decline; if they decline or don't respond in time, the request closes and you are never charged.
requests.body2: Once a host accepts, you have {hours} hours to complete payment. If the payment window lapses, the hold is released and — as always — nothing is charged.

refunds.heading: How refunds are paid
refunds.body1: Refunds go back to the original payment method automatically. Depending on your bank, mada and card refunds typically appear within a few business days.
refunds.body2: If an automatic refund can't be processed, our team completes it manually and you'll receive a confirmation email — you never need to chase it.

hostCancellations.heading: If a host cancels
hostCancellations.body: If a host has to cancel — weather on the mountain is real — you're refunded in full, no matter how close to the start it happens.

helpFaq.title: Questions, answered.
helpFaq.intro: The short version of everything guests and hosts ask us. Can't find yours? Use "report a problem" on any booking page and a real person in Abha will reply.

booking.q: How do I book an experience?
booking.a: Pick a date on the experience page, choose your group size, and submit. Instant Book experiences confirm as soon as you pay; request-to-book experiences go to the host first, who responds within {approvalHours} hours.

payment.a: Instant Book: at checkout, and your spot is confirmed immediately. Request to book: only after the host accepts — you'll get a secure payment link by email and on your booking page. A declined or expired request is never charged.

pending.a: Your request is with the host. They have {approvalHours} hours to accept or decline — if you shared an email, we'll notify you the moment they respond, and this page always shows the latest status. Until they accept, no money moves.

cancel.a: Yes — any time before the experience starts, from your booking page. Refunds follow the experience's cancellation policy (Flexible, Moderate or Strict) shown when you booked: a full refund up to that policy's deadline, and on Moderate and Strict a 50% refund for a while after. You can also move your booking to another open date once, free of charge.

contactHost.q: How do I reach my host?
contactHost.a: Once a booking is confirmed, your booking page shows a WhatsApp line straight to the host for meeting-point details and day-of coordination.

becomeHost.q: How do I become a host?
becomeHost.a: Apply from the "Host with us" page. We review every application, verify identity and licences, and then build the experience together with you — photography included.

payout.q: When do I get paid as a host?
payout.a: A payout is earned when a booking is completed. We transfer what you're owed to your Saudi IBAN and record every transfer in the payout ledger in your dashboard — where you can also update your IBAN at any time.

hostCancel.q: What if I have to cancel as a host?
hostCancel.a: Cancel from your bookings page as early as you can. The guest is notified and any payment is refunded in full automatically, no matter how close to the start it happens.

requestWindow.q: How long do I have to answer a booking request?
requestWindow.a: {approvalHours} hours. Accept and the guest receives a secure payment link; decline or let the window lapse and the request expires — the guest is never charged either way.

editListing.q: Can I change my experience after it's published?
editListing.a: Yes — edit the details, pause the listing, or adjust day-by-day availability from your dashboard whenever you need. Confirmed bookings keep the price and terms they were booked with.

termsPage.title: Terms of service
termsPage.intro: The agreement between you and Gharmish when you browse, book, or host — written to be read. Last updated 7 July 2026.

platform.heading: What Gharmish is
platform.body1: Gharmish is an online marketplace that connects guests with independent local hosts offering experiences in the Aseer region of Saudi Arabia. Gharmish operates the platform, handles payments, and supports both sides — the experience itself is created and delivered by the host.
platform.body2: We vet every host before they appear on the platform, but hosts are not Gharmish employees, and each experience page describes what the individual host offers.

accounts.heading: Your account
accounts.body1: You must be 18 or older to book or host. Keep your account details accurate — we use your phone number and email to deliver booking confirmations, payment links, and time-sensitive updates.
accounts.body2: You are responsible for activity on your account. If you believe someone else has accessed it, contact us right away.

bookingsPayments.heading: Bookings and payment
bookingsPayments.body1: All prices are in Saudi Riyals, and the price shown is the final amount you pay — inclusive of any applicable taxes, with nothing added at checkout. Instant Book experiences are confirmed as soon as your payment succeeds. Request-to-book experiences are confirmed only after the host accepts within {approvalHours} hours and you complete payment within {payHours} hours of acceptance.
bookingsPayments.body2: Payments are processed by a licensed third-party payment provider supporting mada, Visa, Mastercard, and Apple Pay. Gharmish never stores your full card details.

cancellations.heading: Cancellations and refunds
cancellations.body: Each experience carries one of three cancellation policies (Flexible, Moderate or Strict), shown on its page and fixed on your booking at the moment you book: a full refund up to the policy's deadline, a 50% refund for a further window on Moderate and Strict, and no refund past that. Cancelling within 24 hours of booking always refunds in full while the start is at least 48 hours away; one free date change is included within the policy's window.

conduct.heading: Guest conduct
conduct.body: Arrive on time, follow the host's safety instructions, and treat hosts, other guests, and the places you visit with respect. Behaviour that endangers others or violates Saudi law or local customs can lead to a cancelled booking without refund and removal from the platform.

hosts.heading: Hosting on Gharmish
hosts.body: Hosts agree to describe their experiences accurately, hold the licences and permits their activity requires, honour confirmed bookings, and deliver what the listing promises.

content.heading: Reviews and content
content.body: Reviews must reflect a genuine booking and an honest experience. We may remove content that is abusive, misleading, or unlawful, and we may suspend accounts that misuse the platform.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: Experiences are created and delivered by independent hosts, who are solely responsible for their experiences — including safety, permits, licensing, and any harm arising from them. Gharmish does not provide insurance for hosts or guests; experiences carry the inherent risks of the activity described on their page, and you participate at your own risk. To the extent permitted by law, Gharmish's liability is limited to the amount you paid for the booking concerned. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under Saudi law.

changes.heading: Changes and governing law
changes.body1: We may update these terms as the platform evolves; material changes will be posted here with a new date. Continuing to use Gharmish after a change means you accept the updated terms.
changes.body2: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the Saudi courts.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: What we collect, why, and the choices you have — in plain language, under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Last updated 7 July 2026.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.body1: Account details you give us: your name, phone number, and email address. Booking details: the experience, date, group size, and any notes you share with a host. If you apply to host, we also collect identity-verification details — your legal name, national ID or commercial registration, date of birth, payout IBAN, and the documents you upload. They're used only to verify your application and pay your earnings, stored privately, and never shown to guests.
collect.body2: Payment is handled by our licensed payment provider — your card details go directly to them, and Gharmish never stores your full card number. We also keep technical records such as sign-in events and error logs to keep the platform secure and working.

use.heading: How we use it
use.body: To run your bookings and payments, send confirmations, reminders, payment links, and status updates by email or SMS, answer support requests, prevent fraud and abuse, and meet our legal obligations. We don't sell your personal data.

sharing.heading: Who we share it with
sharing.body1: Your host sees what they need to run the experience: your name, group size, and — once a booking is confirmed — a way to coordinate with you. Hosts never see your payment details.
sharing.body2: We use trusted service providers to operate the platform — payment processing, hosting, databases, email and SMS delivery, and error monitoring — and they process data on our instructions only. We disclose data to authorities when Saudi law requires it.

storage.heading: Where your data lives
storage.body: Our databases are hosted with international cloud providers, including in the European Union. Wherever data is processed, we apply the same safeguards and handle cross-border transfers in line with the PDPL.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep booking and payment records for as long as needed to run your account and to meet Saudi tax and commercial record-keeping requirements. Data with no remaining purpose is deleted or anonymised.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: Under the PDPL you can ask what personal data we hold about you, request a copy, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete what we're not legally required to keep.
rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: We use the cookies the platform needs to work: keeping you signed in and remembering your language. If you choose "Accept all" in our cookie banner, we also set marketing cookies from Snapchat and TikTok to measure how our ads perform; declining them changes nothing about how Gharmish works, and you can clear your browser cookies at any time to be asked again.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change how we handle personal data, we'll update this page and revise the date at the top. Significant changes will be flagged more prominently.
